items.project_definition: A positive, sequential, and unique integer used to distinguish each entry, calculated as the maximum existing value plus one.
The structured text format used for the persistent storage file located at ~/.todos.json, containing an array of objects.
The time standard used for the immutable creation timestamp, formatted according to ISO 8601.
The operational command that triggers a state change from pending to a finished status for a specific record.
The operational command that transitions a record from either pending or finished status to a deleted state.
